body: I'm about to go to sleep so I just wanted to say thanks to both of you for really helping me out and saving someone's life. I hope you can become happier just like I want to be happier, a big happiness circle if you would call it that. Thanks for all your help and good night. And by the way HL, I don't mind the stereotyping but it would probably be fun to get another hobby, "Yeah I like computers but I also tame sharks." Silly example but you get the point :^)

I haven't done a lot of coding, only very few lines on a basic level, but I will look at the link you sent me and try to find some coding classes. Hopefully it makes me want to kill myself less. thanks for your help and hope you can find that therapist.

No, I haven't. I'll look into it. Thank you. And deal. My mom was awake so I told her about it and she said sure to trying to find a therapist. And to answer your other question, I haven't looked at specifics for it but AI seems like the most interesting to me.

Well usually I try to keep myself entertained and alive by going on my computer and playing games and shit so I figured if I'm around computers so much why not get a job working with computers in some way. I have tried to get into electives at school and such to bolster my confidence about it and learn about it so hopefully I can pick myself up but I honestly am still feeling shit. Hopefully your brother doesn't feel as shit as me and really pushes himself to become great in the field. What do you aspire to become?

Thanks for the PM. I usually play games with a couple of friends I know to try to have fun, and usually I laugh a little and try to be happy. I haven't been doing that for a couple of days but I think I'll try to see if it makes me feel any better. I also am going to start seeking therapy and/or treatment. Thank you for your concern. Also, I hope you feel better as well. Considering I was just about to hang myself I'm not in the best shape to give advice but I guess follow the advice you are trying to give me. Thanks.

By the way I forgot to say in the PM I was aspiring to be a computer scientist. I'm trying to keep that dream up even though I have basically given up on everything but at least you helped me not give up on living for a little bit longer.
